# Epoch handoff: what may change across epochs, what must not

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`open-ended-epoch-handoff` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](open-ended-epoch-handoff.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Upgrades passing an EpochHandoffGate (anchored, target certified and total, live headroom) keep the original floor and current guard over every run; one epoch gives anchored_selfMod_viable exactly; dropping only the anchor lets a floor-lowering run drain to 0 inside its own kernel.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. RegimeMargin.Coupled.Indexed.Rises for G; EpochCert of the starting epoch; starting state in its K; lag margin x_crit + eta * (sitePreCap + envCap) <= x0 on in-scope sites. Non-deadlock: EpochTotal of the starting epoch and the starting state in K.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That any actual system meets EpochCert, AnchorStep or the gate (recognition, Rule 2).
- Substrate draw during a real switchover; a substrate law or environment draw that changes across epochs.
- Which unmodelled sites should enter scope, or when.
- The composed gate of Part 5 as the gate of a joint epoch family.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading (AI-written): what is evolvable (modes, sensors, capabilities, envelopes) and what is anchored (substrate law, floors in scope, environment bounds) must be separated, and the anchored side may only tighten; moving a floor to the evolvable side is the wireheading route, and freezing capabilities on the anchored side is lock-in.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
